messages:
Olivia Park: Quick sync - we need a one-page solution brief + micro-landing for enterprise prospects that emphasizes security controls, SLA guardrails, and deployment options. Goal: procurement-friendly copy, explicit lead-routing rules, a benchmark callout (conservative), and two CTA variants for an A/B test. Ideas?

Dev Patel: Headline idea: 'Trusted inference for regulated teams: secure, predictable, and deployable where you need it.' Micro-sections: Data Protection, Reliability SLA, Deployment Paths. Keep each to 3 crisp bullets and a tiny decision guide.

Hannah Reed: For the benchmark box, propose conservative verified language: "Internal Redwood lab: Dedicated with KV caching + int8 quantization reduced unit cost ~28% at sustained embedding throughput; p99 gen latency ~95ms on our benchmark model. Internal results; customer workloads may vary." We'll avoid absolute claims.

Tomás Alvarez: Lead-routing rules (proposal): add form fields [deployment_preference, compliance_level, expected_monthly_tokens, procurement_timeline_days, prefer_sales_contact]. Routing pseudocode for handoff:
```
if compliance_level == 'high' or deployment_preference == 'Private' or expected_monthly_tokens > 5_000_000:
  route_to('AE')
elif procurement_timeline_days < 30 and expected_monthly_tokens > 500_000:
  route_to('SolutionsEng')
else:
  route_to('SelfServe')
```
Also include webhook mapping example for the growth stack: tag 'enterprise-signal' when route_to != 'SelfServe'.

Olivia Park: Nice. Also want an MQL scoring tweak: +20 points for compliance_level=='high', +15 for deployment_preference!='Hosted', +10 if expected_monthly_tokens > 1M. This feeds into CRM to trigger AE outreach.

Hannah Reed: Visuals: small trust badges area with icons for "Customer-managed KMS", "VPC / Private Control Plane", "Audit Logs & Retention Controls". Suggest micro-copy under badges: "Options vary by deployment; legal sign-off required for certification claims."

LegalBot: Language check: recommend qualifiers. Use: "supports customer-managed KMS and audit logs, VPC/private control plane options, and configurable data retention." For SLA: "SLA-backed uptime subject to standard exclusions (scheduled maintenance, force majeure)." Do not claim certifications (SOC2/FedRAMP) unless documented. Replace any absolute wording like 'guaranteed' with 'SLA-backed'.

Tomás Alvarez: Webinar plan: 40-min technical session (20-min architecture + 10-min benchmarks + 10-min live Q&A). Proposed date: Jan 18, 2026. Suggest an invited customer speaker (neutral anonymized quote) and a Solutions Eng demo of deployment flows. Dry run Jan 16.

Dev Patel: CTA A/B test options: A) 'Request enterprise trial' -> starts a guided trial flow with optional AE follow-up; B) 'Schedule a secure review' -> direct AE booking. Track conversion and time-to-SQL. Also propose a micro-CTA in PDF: 'Download procurement checklist'.

Hannah Reed: Procurement checklist (condensed): 1) DPA & security questionnaire, 2) Network diagram & IP allowlist, 3) Expected throughput & data residency requirements, 4) Contracting timeline estimates (Hosted: 14-30 days, Dedicated: 30-60 days, Private: 45-90 days). Keep as 4 bullets.

Olivia Park: For messaging iteration: we'll run the landing copy in two variants: more technical (emphasize KV caching, quantization, p99), and procurement-first (emphasize docs, timeline, SLAs). We'll measure MQL quality and AE feedback.

Tomás Alvarez: Include a tiny decision matrix: Hosted = fastest onboarding; Dedicated = predictable throughput + cost savings; Private = air-gapped & regulatory controls. Add an icon row for each.

GrowthBot: Promo plan queued: blog post + targeted email to accounts with >200 seats + in-product banner for trial users. I'll attach UTM templates and RSVP page skeleton.

LegalBot: I'll run final copy check once draft is in. Reminder: the phrase 'internal lab' must be present next to benchmark numbers.

Olivia Park: Action items: @Tomás - produce routing pseudocode + webhook map; @Hannah - two hero variants + procurement checklist copy; @Dev - MQL scoring & CRM mapping; @LegalBot - final sign-off on phrasing. I'll assemble the one-pager draft and share by end of week.
